introduction: Legal Aid Services of Oklahoma offers civil legal help to qualifying residents. Its online application has a follow-up telephone step; submission alone does not complete intake.
description: Legal Aid Services of Oklahoma offers civil legal help to qualifying residents. Its online application has a follow-up telephone step; submission alone does not complete intak

sections.who: LASO screens household income, household size and the civil legal issue. Criminal cases are outside the service described on its intake page.
sections.get: The provider assesses whether advice, legal information or representation can be offered.

sections.apply:
1. Apply online or telephone

    Use LASO intake. Telephone applications use 888-534-5243 or 918-428-4357, Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

  2. Complete both online steps

    Submit the form, then check your email and call the priority number provided. Without email, use telephone intake.

  3. Explain urgency

    Tell staff about hearings, eviction notices or safety concerns and supply requested papers.
sections.after: Ask whether representation has been accepted and what you must do next. Continue following court instructions while intake is pending.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using LASO eligibility and two-step intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: No. LASO instructs applicants to check email and telephone the priority number to complete intake.
What if I have no email?
The provider directs you to call 888-534-5243.
Its intake page describes civil, non-criminal help.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
